title: sdks: unify auth/retries, streaming ergonomics, parity fixes, and version bumps
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: unify auth and retry semantics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, improve streaming ergonomics (cancelation, backpressure signals), fix parity gaps in method naming and edge-case error propagation, and bump SDK versions for a coordinated release. This PR consolidates previous per-language work and applies consistent patterns: (1) a shared auth token refresh hook and clarified env var precedence; (2) retry policy refactor to expose a RetryPolicy object with deterministic jitter and per-call overrides; (3) streaming client-side ergonomics: explicit close/cancel APIs, optional buffered iterator, proper propagation of underlying transport errors; (4) parity fixes for parameter names and response envelopes across languages; (5) package version bumps and changelogs for Python, TS, and Go. Checklist: - [x] Shared auth hook implemented and wired into all SDKs - [x] Retry policy implementation with unit tests and docs - [x] Streaming ergonomics API surfaced with examples - [x] Parity fixes for method names and response shapes - [x] Version bumps and changelogs updated - [x] CI green (lint, unit, integration, e2e) - [x] Manual smoke test on hosted API samples Notes: This description is intentionally a single continuous string. For follow-ups: split the shared hook into a standalone package if adoption across internal tools increases; consider opt-in telemetry for retry metrics per request. Related: ENG-4821 (SDK parity), ENG-5010 (streaming ergonomics), SUP-1287 (customer report about auth-refresh edge case).
